open_violations.detail: Domain depends outward on 7 legacy Services: LoyaltyService, PricingRuleEngine, Pricing/DailyPricingCalculator, Pricing/FirstBookingDiscountPricingCalculator, Pricing/ReferralPricingCalculator, Pricing/ScreenPricingResolver, SettingsService
